scope: development smoke; one frozen source checkpoint, one simulator seed, ten state/joint probes including a six-probe quality-passed role-paired subset, three Teacher seeds per family

collection.failure_reason: duplicate-baseline tangent/force divergence above the fixed collection-noise limits

probe_diagnosis.frame5_right_ankle: both families predict the wrong direction; V2-A1 has larger wrong-direction gain
probe_diagnosis.frame25_right_ankle: V2-A1 has higher gain and correct direction; V1 has correct direction but nearly zero gain
probe_diagnosis.frame49_left_ankle: V2-A1 responds more strongly but predicts the opposite direction; V1 direction is mostly correct but gain is about two percent

decision.reason: V1 nearly ignores action deltas. V2-A1 has larger tangent sensitivity but is directionally inconsistent across feet, and both families ignore almost all normal-force sensitivity.
decision.next_architecture_action: Do not promote MoE or Actor integration. Add an explicit actuator-state/action-plan contract and train action-contrastive counterfactual supervision before retrying the gate.
